name: One bad message blocks its whole group (FIFO head-of-line blocking)
description: Account changes must be applied in order, so the queue is FIFO: one message per account group at a time. A few messages are bad (poison, 1 in 1,000) and fail every time; with at-least-once delivery each one comes back after the visibility timeout, fails again, and goes to the DLQ only after 5 tries. For those ~50 s every later message of its group waits (see the queue's "Waited behind its group" and the async p99). Try this: (1) raise the queue's "Message groups" from 8 to 256: a poison message blocks 1/256 of the accounts; (2) lower the visibility timeout from 10 s to 2 s, or "Max receives" from 5 to 2: bad messages reach the DLQ sooner; (3) if order does not matter, switch back to "Standard" and a bad message blocks no one.
